text:
sre_maya: seeing a sudden spike of 503s for hosted inference in us-east-1 starting ~12:05 UTC, looks correlated with upstream runner exits (SIGSEGV/driver reset). customers reporting timeouts and retries.

support_jen: got an inbound from Acme (prod) — multiple requests retried, doubled billing lines. they started at 12:04.

eng_oncall_dan: thx. can someone post a short log snippet from the runner pods and nvidia-smi output? suspect NVML GPU reset or a memory growth bug.

ml_infra_li: pasting the tail of the runner log from a recent crash (pod infer-runner-7f8c):

```
[2026-03-17T12:05:22Z] infer-runner[pid=1423]: kv_prefetch: ctx_len=2048 batch=16 prefetch_size=0.92GB
[2026-03-17T12:05:23Z] infer-runner[pid=1423]: GPU[0] mem=11108MB/11264MB nvml_event=GPU_RESET
[2026-03-17T12:05:23Z] infer-runner[pid=1423]: segfault at 0x7ffd... (libcudart.so+0x1f2a3)
[2026-03-17T12:05:23Z] kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[2026-03-17T12:05:24Z] k8s: container restart (ExitCode=139)
```

gpu_ops_bot: auto-alert: gpu-reset-count increased on node gpu-us-east-12 from 0 -> 4 within 3m. driver logs show repeated GPU page-faults preceding reset.

customer_success_ana: Acme reports degraded latency and 503s on routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream, multiple customers affected but only in us-east.

eng_oncall_dan: steps I'll take: 1) repro locally with a long-context prompt + batching, 2) run the runner under asan/valgrind style sanitizer if possible, 3) try toggling KV_PREFETCH. Anyone can confirm a quick mitigation?

ml_infra_li: short-term mitigations we've successfully used before: set KV_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false, reduce default batch size to 4, pin model to 8k-quantized variant, or route critical customers to dedicated fallback pool (no prefetch).

support_jen: pushing mitigations to Acme: reduce concurrency and enable retries/backoff. flagged billing duplicates to billing team — mark for credit if retried.

eng_oncall_dan: repro command I'm running (share if you want to reproduce locally):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-ctx8k","prompt":"'$(python -c 'print("A"*15000)')'","max_tokens":1024,"batch_size":16}'
```

ml_infra_li: note — the crash happens about 30-90s after the request when KV cache prefetch tries to allocate large pinned memory. nvml shows memory steadily increases (leak) until reset.

eng_oncall_dan: quick logs from nvidia-smi sampling during a repro:

```
Time:12:05:10 GPU0 900MB
Time:12:05:20 GPU0 4200MB
Time:12:05:30 GPU0 8200MB
Time:12:05:40 GPU0 11100MB -> reset
```

sre_maya: impact: ~12% of requests returned 503 in the window, retries caused higher tail latency and billing duplicates for customers with aggressive client retry.

ml_infra_li: root-candidate: a combination of prefetch + batch expansion path allocating host-pinned pages but not freeing on certain code paths when a CUDA call errors; leads to driver page fault and eventual reset.

eng_oncall_dan: plan: 1) roll a 30m canary that disables KV prefetch cluster-wide in us-east, 2) reduce batch default to 4, 3) add watchdog to kill runner on first nvml page-fault instead of continuing, 4) gather full minidump and driver logs for GPU vendor.

support_jen: I notified affected customers and offered provisional credits; collecting list of invoices impacted.

customer_success_ana: please keep me posted; Acme is scheduling a wartime call at 13:00 UTC if the canary doesn't reduce 503s.

eng_oncall_dan: taking ownership for the deploy and triage. I'll post canary rollout status here. starting canary now (12:07).

sre_maya: thanks — tagging oncall and driver vendor: @gpu_vendor_support. if we need a hotpatch to runtime, say so and we'll prioritize.

ml_infra_li: saved crash dump and kernel oops to S3: s3://redwood-infra/repro-dumps/4951239876/ — attaching brief steps to reproduce to that object.

eng_oncall_dan: canary observation at 12:18: 503s dropped to baseline in canary subset (10 nodes). full rollout scheduled if stable for 15m.

sre_maya: good progress. follow-up items: permanent fix to free pinned allocations on CUDA error path, add unit test for prefetch under OOM, and confirm billing dedup for retries is handled.

support_jen: noted. will file a support ticket with affected invoices and link to triage notes.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from sre_maya, :eyes: from customer_success_ana)
